question.text: A bull call spread on NIFTY: buy 25000 call @ Rs. 120, sell 25200 call @ Rs. 60. Maximum profit per unit:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Net cost = 120 - 60 = Rs. 60. Max profit = (25200-25000) - 60 = 200 - 60 = Rs. 140. **The Trap:** Other values ignore net premium or spread width. **Cross-Exam Context:** Spread strategy payoff. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Bull call spreads cap both upside and cost — suit PMS-sized directional bets.
